subject: physics

hotspots.label: Resistor Block
hotspots.description: The sliding block whose position changes how much current path the charge must cross.
hotspots.colorHint: A ridged dark-grey block riding the rail.
hotspots.function: Sets the resistance of the path.

hotspots.label: Slide Rail
hotspots.description: The long track; the farther the block, the longer the path current must travel.
hotspots.colorHint: Long metallic rail spanning the base.
hotspots.function: Provides the length knob of resistance.

hotspots.label: Lengthen
hotspots.description: Slides the block away, lengthening the path and raising ohms.
hotspots.function: Increases resistance by adding path length.

hotspots.label: Shorten
hotspots.description: Slides the block back, shortening the path and dropping ohms.
hotspots.function: Decreases resistance by trimming path length.

hotspots.label: Ammeter
hotspots.description: The current gauge — sags as resistance climbs, surges as it falls.
hotspots.function: Reads the current after the drag.

hotspots.label: Bulb
hotspots.description: The bulb that dims as the block lengthens the path.
hotspots.colorHint: Small warm lamp at the end of the line.
hotspots.function: Displays the current's effect on brightness.

hotspots.label: Ohm Readout
hotspots.description: The numeric resistance display in ohms.

hotspots.label: Material Switch
hotspots.description: Flips the block between copper (flows easily) and nichrome (resists hard).
hotspots.function: Changes the block's material and its resistance.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A long metallic rail, a dark resistor block, green ammeter, warm bulb, and a material toggle.
materialNotes: Metallic=0 for parts except rail metallic ~0.6, roughness 0.3. Block dark matte; bulb warm-glass; no bloom.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: resistance as current-path length and material.

GEOMETRY: a horizontal slide rail from x=-1.5..1.5; resistor block slides; bulb at the far end; ammeter; ohm panel; material toggle.

INTERACTION: lengthen/shorten chips move the block; ohms rise with path length; material switch toggles copper (low) vs nichrome (high); ammeter and bulb follow current = V ÷ R.

NAMED NODES: Rail, Block, LengthenChip, ShortenChip, Ammeter, Bulb, OhmPanel, MaterialToggle. 8-11k tris.
